巴拉‧猶大 = "猶大的主人們"

01184 Ba`aley Y@huwdah {bah-al-ay' yeh-hoo-daw'}

from the pl. of 01167 and 03063;; n pr loc

AV - Baale of Judah 1; 1

Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"
1) a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim,
   Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab
